I am passing along the following opportunity.

The MIT Data + Feminism Lab is hiring a one year postdoc! We are working with Andrea Parker (Georgia Tech) and Brooke Foucault-Welles (Northeastern) on a project related to youth as co-designers of civic technologies to support community wellness in their neighborhoods.

The ideal candidate has a background in Human Computer Interaction, experience with both software development and participatory design, and is capable of leading interdisciplinary research with community partners.

Due to budget constraints we cannot support visas/work authorization.

Feel free to email
